lines.en: I creep along the leaf face, slowly.
I hump up, then stretch forward.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶缘绕了一小圈。
lines.en: I loop around the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 我从这片叶爬到那片叶。
lines.en: I crawl from this leaf to that one.
I crawl over the leaf vein.
I have reached the edge of the leaf.
It is all leaves here; enough to walk on.
I shift along under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，可从不离叶。
lines.en: I crawl slowly, and never leave the leaf.
I head where the leaves are thick.
I reach my front half out and test.
I have not left this leaf.
I move up along the twig.
I crawl back and try another way.
I stop on the leaf without moving.
I lift my head, then lower it.
I eat nothing but leaves.
There is nothing else to eat here.
I draw my body in.
My feet hold fast.
I stay under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢这块地方，太空了。
lines.en: I dislike this spot; it is too bare.
My body is soft.
I hear wings above me.
I probe with my front half.
I will stay on this leaf.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看着你那个方向。
lines.en: I lift my head toward you.
You are in the way of the leaf.
I duck under the leaf.
Your finger is bigger than I am.
I will not leave; I am on the leaf.

lines.zh: 你伸过来的东西我不认识。
lines.en: I do not know what you are reaching with.
I draw back slowly.
You have tilted this leaf.

lines.zh: 我要是不在叶上，就活不了。
lines.en: If I am not on a leaf, I will not live.
Do not take me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩成圆圆一团。
lines.en: I curl into a round ball.
I squirmed two or three times.
I nearly fell off the leaf.
That pressure is hard to bear.
I pull my head in.
My body goes stiff for a moment.
I slowly uncurl again.
I can still crawl, a little at a time.
There is nowhere else to hide.
Is that a leaf up there?
This one thing is all I eat.
Put the leaf down.
I know that smell well.
I crawl toward it.
I went up and took a nibble.
That is not enough to last until I am grown.
I want to eat while staying on a leaf.
Set it down beside me.
I cling to the leaf face and do not fall.
I slowly roll back upright.

lines.zh: 我只吃叶子，掉下去就会饿。
lines.en: I eat only leaves; fall off and I starve.
Do not touch me; I am soft.
I move away from the leaf edge.
I crawl back onto the vein.

lines.zh: 我咬住叶缘，腿都绷直了。
lines.en: I bite the leaf edge; every leg goes taut.
Don't step on me — I only eat leaves.
Not in this shape.
Wait until I am a butterfly.
I am only a caterpillar.
Not at this stage.
I go back to chewing leaves.
That question is pointless now.
I must grow big enough first.
I crawl away.
We can talk of it later.
This is on the leaf.
I gave it one lick.
Not a leaf; I will not eat it.
I pushed and it did not move.
It is in my way.

lines.zh: 那东西挡路，我换根枝条。
lines.en: That thing blocks the way; I switch to another twig.
I bite it and spit it out.
It is stuck to my feet.
I cannot shake this off.
I am ignoring it.
I stop and lift my head.
Something is on the move.
I shrink under the leaf.
There is nowhere for me to hide.
I can only cling to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成叶脉上的一点。
lines.en: I shrink to a speck on the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和叶子不太像。
lines.en: My color does not match the leaf well.

lines.zh: 我不动，也许就看不见我。
lines.en: If I stay still, perhaps I will not be seen.
I dare not crawl to the edge.
Wait for it to leave.
I stay pressed where I am.

lines.zh: 我除了这片叶，哪儿也去不了。
lines.en: Apart from this leaf, I have nowhere to go.
I shift a very little.
I hide beside the leaf vein.
I hear it nearby.
If I do not move, perhaps it will go.
I shrink further under the leaf.
This leaf is getting smaller.
I am still clinging to this leaf.
I cannot even shift away.
I curl under the leaf.

lines.zh: 这一下压得我贴住了叶子。
lines.en: That pressed me flat to the leaf.
I have been rolled over.
All I can do is squirm.
I push at it with my front half.
I am still on the leaf.
Do not press your weight down.
A small grub appears on the leaf's underside.
I have only lately left the egg.
I have landed on a leaf.
There are many leaves here; good.
I test the leaf under me.
I take my first bite.
I crawl up along the vein.
I lift my head toward the light.
This patch will feed me a long while.
I press myself to the leaf face.

lines.zh: 热气把我的身体烤得发干。
lines.en: The heat dries my body out.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉到地上，摔了一下。
lines.en: I fall from the leaf and hit the ground.
Water soaks through me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从叶子上卷走。
lines.en: The blast rips me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西打穿了叶子，就在我旁边。
lines.en: Something pierced the leaf right beside me.

lines.zh: 离开叶子太久，我快撑不住了。
lines.en: Away from leaves too long, I am failing.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我整个缩了起来。
lines.en: The thunder makes me curl right up.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有叶子的地方。
lines.en: I fall somewhere with no leaves.
